spokeo.evidence: Homepage form id homepage_hero_form (q) GETs /search?q=<name>, which forwards to the nationwide /<First>-<Last> page; the site's location pages are /<First>-<Last>/<State>/<City>, and it forwards the lowercase path with a state code there. Storing the location path narrows a common name to the person's city instead of the nationwide list. Frame fills path placeholders as lowercase slugs and stops the path before the first segment it cannot fill, so a person with no city still gets the name (and state) page.
